title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
reason: Major exchange security breach with significant financial impact, distinct from the recent Binance hack.

sources.summary: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
reason: Major financial disclosure from a frontier AI lab revealing significant operating losses ahead of IPO.

sources.summary: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.
